info.name: Pure activity dataSet API
dataSet
Lists all data sets

params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned data sets per request.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the returned list. 0 or null value is from the start

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /data sets/orderings

items.docs: Lists all data sets in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the data sets returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

info.name: Query operation for data sets

items.docs: Lists data sets in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.

items.docs: Mark the content as external (used when content contains synchronised data). This has no effect on interactions with the content through the API.

info.name: Unlock the content

params.description: UUID of the content to unlock

items.docs: Remove the external mark on the content (used when content contains synchronised data). This has no effect on interactions with the content through the API.

info.name: Lists all dependents to a  data set

items.docs: Lists all dependents to a data set with the specified UUID. If the user does not have access to view all the dependent content, an authorization error will be thrown.
